title: Routing with ServeMux
hints: Since Go 1.22, ServeMux patterns can name a method and wildcards: mux.HandleFunc("GET /hello/{name}", ...). r.PathValue("name") reads the wildcard.
A pattern with a method answers 405 Method Not Allowed for other methods by itself, and a GET pattern also matches HEAD.
For the echo route, io.Copy(w, r.Body) writes the request body back.
